requiredFindings.title: Native ACL capture refusals still latch the shared discovery ledger
requiredFindings.description: layout uses judge_project_object / judge_file, which call capture_descriptor_acl_accounted. On macOS capture_accounted_in returns native capture errors from inside work.run. Non-I/O DescriptorAclCaptureError values (Changed, Malformed, Unsupported) therefore latch the ledger before chain_failure translates them to VcsUnsupported and member_failure translates them to a per-member refusal. A later member fails Budget(Closed); even a single-member outer ledger.scope cannot return the refused verdict successfully. The same issue can affect pass-level global-source custody capture. Mode/owner refusals are decided outside the capture scope and do not demonstrate this path.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Give 6b a custody/capture path that preserves the same charges and refusal subjects while returning ordinary capture outcomes as values until outside charged scopes; retain genuine host I/O and budget failures as pass failures and keep 6a unchanged. Add deterministic native-capture failure controls for Changed and another non-I/O capture error, including a refused first member followed by a valid member, a lone refused member, and pass-level source capture. Verify the enclosing ledger remains usable for handled refusals.

requiredFindings.title: NoRepository proof is not bound to the root used for member observation
requiredFindings.description: NoRepository borrows only a TrackingObservation, which stores a tracking enum and samples without a retained root binding. observe_members ignores its _root argument and takes W exclusively from independently supplied TrackingInputs.chain. A caller can obtain a token for non-repository W_A and pass it with the chain for W_B inside a repository. The function then checks only descendants of W_B and can admit a conventional member beneath W_B, violating W2 despite satisfying its Rust signature. The existing precondition test only checks that an observation of W_B itself returns None.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Bind the proof to the exact observed retained root/chain and have observe_members derive W from it or validate the inputs against that binding before member work. Add a cross-root substitution control with W_A outside any repository and W_B inside one; the token for W_A must not authorize W_B. Do not resolve this solely by a caller convention.

nonBlockingObservations.title: The linked-worktree mutation log is not in the pinned evidence
nonBlockingObservations.description: controls.json reports nine caught mutations and the runner includes linked-worktree-dropped, but only eight mutation logs are manifest members and present in the archived checks directory. The linked-worktree-dropped log is missing. The ordinary commondir control and mutation recipe are inspectable, so this does not independently block the code review; include that log in the next evidence package.
